title: 路已经打开

source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 120 BPM, short original six-second instrumental victory fanfare: clear pickup, modest rising brass-like pulse phrase, warm resolved final chord with a clean natural tail. Humane relief after protecting others, no vocal celebration. Finish completely; after the cadence leave silence. A single short complete musical notification, not a song or repeating loop. Resolve the final cadence by 6 seconds, then let the final note decay naturally into quiet silence. No new phrase after the final chord.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: preserve full onset, search low-energy cadence; retain full source when no natural early tail found

auditory_review_note: Objective measurements only; no claim of human or model listening. Music content, absence of vocal textures and phrase coherence still need listening.
